blocks.text: From 25 to 27 November 2026, Shangri-La Boracay welcomes Chef Josh Boutwood to Rima Treetop Dining for an exclusive three-night culinary residency. The experience will feature a six-course menu combining signature creations from Helm, his two-Michelin-starred restaurant, with new dishes developed exclusively for Rima. Drawing on influences from different culinary traditions, Chef Josh brings together distinctive flavours and inventive techniques in a menu that reflects his individual approach to cooking. A Dining Experience Above the Treetops Perched high within the forest canopy, Rima Treetop Dining offers an elevated experience where nature and understated luxury come together.
